whenToUse: A persistent inline status in a page, card or form: unsaved revision, missing tax ID, trial ending.
Explaining why an action is unavailable, next to where it would be.
A form-level error summary above the fields.
avoidWhen: Feedback after an action that should not stay — use Toast.
Decisions the user must make before continuing — use Alert Dialog.
Site-wide time-boxed notices on a website — use Announcement bar.
a11y: Danger and warning alerts use role=alert only when they appear dynamically; static ones stay plain regions.
Never rely on tone colour alone — the title must say what happened.
